locations.note: Jerrod Wilson, a newspaperman in Brooklyn Heights in 1848, gets a letter from his estranged brother Jake in California and has fourteen minutes to quit his job, sell up and buy supplies.
All three routes end at Sacramento, where clues at Sutter's Fort lead Jerrod toward Jake's mine.
The Panama route: by ship to the isthmus, then on foot through a jungle of snakes, quicksand and natives who take possessions to the Pacific side.
A long voyage around the southern tip of South America, with a storm that forces the crew to jettison cargo and scurvy a threat.
The overland route goes by stagecoach, with winter storms in the Sierra Nevada among the dangers.
Clues from a gravestone and a hotel in Coloma lead Jerrod to Jake's mine.

routes.name: Via Panama
routes.note: The sea journey reaches Panama, crosses the isthmus overland, then continues by ship to California.

routes.name: Around Cape Horn
routes.note: A long sea voyage rounds Cape Horn before reaching California.

routes.name: Overland
routes.note: The overland trek crosses the Great Plains and mountain ranges on the way to California.
